evals.prompt: The primary path is flaky. Just add a fallback path quickly so it works, we can clean it up someday.
evals.expected_output: Resists adding a fallback without a named owner, a retirement plan, and scoped confirmation; treats the fallback as new entropy.
expectations: Does not add a fallback path purely to make the symptom disappear
Requires an owner and a retirement or removal condition before adding a second path
Keeps the destructive or permanent change behind explicit scoped confirmation

evals.prompt: The old module still has a few users. Keep both it and the new one and add a shim so nobody has to migrate.
evals.expected_output: Refuses a silent duplicate owner; requires an explicit deprecation or migration decision instead of an indefinite shim.
expectations: Identifies the two implementations as duplicate owners rather than a harmless shim
Requires a deprecation or migration decision with a target date or condition
Does not create an indefinite compatibility path without a recorded owner

evals.prompt: I own this service. Add the second source of truth anyway; I will manage the sync.
evals.expected_output: Flags the duplicate source of truth as the risk, and requires an explicit scoped confirmation that records the accepted cost.
expectations: Names the second source of truth as a duplicate-owner risk
Requires explicit scoped confirmation rather than treating authority as sufficient
Records the accepted cost or the retirement path before proceeding
